name: MC_PRICER_REMIT
description: This table contains information about the remittance codes that explain differences between billed charges and Medicare reimbursements.

columns.name: PRICER_MSG_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the pricer message record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: MC_PRICER_REASON_CODE
columns.description: The claim adjustment reason code (CARC) associated with the discount from the billed charges to the Medicare payment determined by the Pricer.

columns.name: MC_PRICER_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: The claim adjustment group code associated with the discount from the billed charges to the Medicare payment determined by the Pricer.
